name: singevery-desktop
description: Transparent desktop widget that recognizes music (Shazam/AudD) and shows synced karaoke lyrics with romaji — sing along without blocking your screen.
author: Gris

scripts.dev:wait-electron:nix: npm run build:electron && wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development ELECTRON_DISABLE_SECURITY_WARNINGS=1 ELECTRON_DISABLE_GPU=1 electron .
scripts.dev:wait-electron:win: npm run build:electron && wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development ELECTRON_DISABLE_SECURITY_WARNINGS=1 electron .
scripts.build:smtc: dotnet publish ../../native/smtc/EspejoSmtc.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:SelfContained=true --artifacts-path build/dotnet-artifacts -o build/smtc-dist
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run notices && npm run verify:package-inputs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml && npm run verify:package-output
scripts.package:installer: node scripts/edit-executable-metadata.cjs && electron-builder --prepackaged release/win-unpacked --config electron-builder.yml && npm run verify:package-output
scripts.package:signed: npm run build && npm run notices && npm run verify:package-inputs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml && npm run verify:package-output
scripts.package:full: npm run build:smtc && npm run package
